Name: Valinn Knight
Information:
**Valinn Knight**

The devas of Arc Valinn are shining stars in the cosmos, who act as her soldiers, commanders, and enforcers. They are slightly different from other devas in practice, in that they adorn themselves with clothing without being required to do so. Their clothing, weapons, and a habit of theirs to adopt mortal technological conveniences are born from Arc Valinn’s dedication to technological advancement, causing her devas to take the culture of mortals and their technology onto themselves.

Valinn Knights are well equipped to fight frame units and astradecks, and float as though in space without wings unlike other more angelic devas.

traits.name: Construct Slayer
traits.description: When the deva attacks or makes a saving throw against a construct, it rolls a d6 and adds it to the result.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: The deva’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. They can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
traits.additional_text: The deva does not make Eidomancy checks.

traits.name: Macro Breaker (Titanic)
traits.description: When a feature or trait targeting the deva would have an effect detrimental to it based on its size (such as maximum macro damage being dealt to creatures its size, or creatures resisting its damage based on its size) the deva is considered to be whatever size would be most beneficial to it for the purposes of those effects, up to a maximum size of Titanic.

traits.name: Piloting Master
traits.description: While the deva is piloting a frame unit or vehicle (both referred to as their vehicle here), it uses the higher proficiency bonus between the two of them for their vehicle’s actions, saves, etc. They can use their vehicle’s Multiattack or Multiaction action without limitations. If that action involves making fewer than three weapon attacks, it can make three weapon attacks instead (using the deva’s attacks for the additional ones).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The deva makes three weapon attacks.

actions.name: Astral Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

actions.name: Astral Railgun
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (1d12 + 7) radiant damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

actions.name: Syn Sign Bullet (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The deva draws a holy symbol in the air then fires their railgun through it, causing an explosive burst of energy at a point it can see within 600 feet. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centred there (120 feet in zero-gravity environment) must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) radiant damage and 22 (4d10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The deva magically transforms into a humanoid of any description, a beast of a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back to its true form. If it dies it reverts to its true form. In any humanoid form its statistics remain the same, but in the form of a beast it assumes the AC, movement speed(s), Strength, Dexterity, senses, attacks, and actions of that beast (except class features, Legendary Actions, and Lair Actions) but retains access to its own actions and senses as well.

bonus_actions.name: Construct Command
bonus_actions.description: The deva casts the command spell using Innate Spellcasting, targeting one construct within range. The command can be harmful to the target, but cannot directly command it to end its life or take action that would immediately lead to that.
